title: Large payouts are being overcharged on the tiered fee schedule
details:
Northwind Trading (merchant m_1, standard schedule) has disputed their February invoice.

They processed a single payment of USD 50,000.00 and were charged a processing fee of USD 900.30.

Their contract prices the standard schedule in tiers: the first 1,000.00 at 2.9%, the next 9,000.00 at
2.4%, and everything above 10,000.00 at 1.8%, plus a flat 0.30 per transaction. Worked through, that is
29.00 + 216.00 + 720.00 + 0.30 = USD 965.30.

We have charged them LESS than the contract says, which is the direction that costs us money, and their
finance team has noticed that our effective rate steps rather than tapering: a 9,999.00 payment and a
10,001.00 payment come out at very different effective rates for almost the same amount. They are asking
whether the tiers are being applied at all.

Small payments (under 1,000.00) invoice correctly, which is most of our volume, so this has not shown up
before now.
